verdict.rationale: Restate ships as a single self-contained binary with no external dependencies, and it runs on a local machine, so the 'one command runs the engine locally' half is well supported. Testing is covered by a TypeScript companion library that runs a real Restate Server in a Docker container via Testcontainers, which makes it integration-style testing rather than in-process unit testing. Missing for 10: any evidence of time-skipping for durable timers in tests, mocked or stubbed steps (e.g. mocking ctx.run results), testing utilities for SDKs other than TypeScript, and independent hands-on corroboration of the testing experience.
